# Where to Watch The Pilgrim's Progress


by Angel | October 13, 2026


In *The Pilgrim’s Progress* , one man discovers a truth he can’t ignore—and a burden he can’t carry alone. After reading a book that reveals the reality of sin and judgment, Pilgrim leaves the City of Destruction behind and sets out for the Celestial City, where a good and noble King awaits.


Along the way, he encounters unexpected allies, dangerous enemies, and trials that challenge his faith and determination.


Based on John Bunyan’s timeless allegory, this animated adventure brings a classic story of faith, courage, and redemption to the screen.


[The Pilgrim’s Progress is streaming now on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/pilgrims-progress)


### **An Animated Adventure About Faith and Courage**


With its journey toward a distant city, dangerous encounters, and a determined hero, *The Pilgrim’s Progress* has the ingredients of an epic adventure.


But the story’s greatest challenges aren’t simply physical. Pilgrim must hold on to his purpose when fear, temptation, and opposition threaten to turn him away from the path. His progress depends on more than determination alone; it requires faith in the King whose city he hopes to reach.


The film combines the excitement of Pilgrim’s travels with themes of salvation, courage, and spiritual growth. His experiences invite audiences to reflect on the burdens they carry, the truths that shape their lives, and the hope that makes the journey worthwhile.


### **The Timeless Story of John Bunyan**


First published in 1678, *The Pilgrim’s Progress* by John Bunyan has remained one of the most influential works of Christian literature for more than three centuries.


Bunyan wrote the allegory to explore the Christian journey through the experiences of an ordinary man seeking salvation. Rather than presenting faith as an abstract idea, the story gives spiritual struggles a physical form. Burdens must be carried, obstacles must be faced, and the destination must be pursued.


The result is a story that speaks across generations. Pilgrim’s journey explores questions of faith, temptation, perseverance, and redemption through a series of memorable encounters.


This animated adaptation brings that allegorical world to life, making the classic story accessible to a new generation while preserving its central message.


### **A Story Families Can Experience Together**


Although John Bunyan’s original book was published centuries ago, its central themes remain relevant today.


*The Pilgrim’s Progress* offers families an opportunity to explore questions of faith through a story filled with adventure, memorable characters, and meaningful choices. Pilgrim’s struggles provide natural opportunities to talk about perseverance, temptation, forgiveness, and what it means to keep moving forward when life becomes difficult.


Viewers have embraced the adaptation as a shared family experience. One reviewer called it “the best adaptation I’ve seen, and I’ve seen nearly all of them.” Another shared, “My friends and my kiddos loved watching this together.”


For families looking for an animated film with both an engaging story and a lasting message, Pilgrim’s journey offers plenty to discuss after the credits roll.
